issues.issue: The back fabric still reads as soft white snow-flecks on blue with cloudy patches, not ANA's crisp grey tweed mosaic. The light dashes dominate, the navy dashes almost vanish at cabin distance, and the rows blur together. This is the largest surface in every PY view.
issues.evidence: q14 back against py_37301: dark fraction (<0.75x the median) 0.07 against 0.16 (py_37303 0.29, py_37302 mid 0.33); local p5/p95 -28/+50 against -49/+51; skew 0.99 against 0.02; gradient energy 12/17 against 20/31; lag-1 vertical autocorrelation 0.49 against 0.18, so the 6.8 mm rows (about 2.3 px at this distance) are mip-blurred into blobs. q13 mid rows: dark 0.14 against 0.33, skew 0.55 against -0.80.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_back: (1) Balance the tones: out = (1 + 1.9*lite) * (1 - 0.62*dark), down from 2.8 / 0.45, and widen the dark dash band. The dark dashes use the same 'band' as the light ones; give them their own band at yc + ph/2 (between the rows) with half-width 2.8 px, so they do not share rows with the light dashes and survive the mip. (2) Increase dark dash length N(16,4) -> N(20,4), clip 10-28. (3) Coarsen the rows so they survive minification: rows 24 -> 18 per tile (pitch 9 mm), which keeps 2 px or more per row at q14 distance; py_37305 at about 1000 px/m allows 7-9 mm. (4) Drop the 'dim[dom<0.3]=0.4' clouds to 0.6, because the blotches read as soft clouds. Targets on q14: dark fraction 0.15 or more, skew below 0.3, local p5 about -45, lag-1 vertical autocorrelation below 0.35. Integration (not PY): confirm that the anisotropic filtering in 01_gl.js:201 takes effect in the QA browser. SwiftShader may not expose it, which would explain the blur.

issues.issue: The navy flap reads as an I-beam or spool: a protruding top bar, a hem shelf that catches a bright edge line, and a step where the curled lower half meets the upper half. ANA's flap is one smooth sheet with soft corners that wraps over the top, with a flush stitched hem.
issues.evidence: q13 foreground and mid seats (crop cmp2): bright horizontal lines at the top and bottom, the top corners appear to flare, and the q14 flap has 'lite' 0.17 at p98/p50 2.0 from the hem edge against 0.02 in py_37301. py_37302 fg flap: clean rectangle; py_37305: flush hem.
issues.fix: 09b_py.js: make the over-top piece the same plane depth and pull it back. gRBox(0.26, 0.008, 0.07) -> gRBox(0.252, 0.008, 0.05, 0.004, 1) at trs(0, 0.906, -0.045), so it no longer overhangs the face. Hem: put the gBox(0.256, 0.022, 0.002) flush (dz -0.0045 -> -0.0041) and colour it '#2f3866' (close to the flap) so it reads as stitching, not a shelf. Hinge the lower half at its top edge: FL rotation 6 -> 3 deg, and overlap the halves by 1 cm (lower half height 0.135 -> 0.145) so no step shows. Corner radius on both halves 0.006 -> 0.015.
